text:
paul_billing: Acquirer opened dispute dp_9Zx8 for INV-110233 (cardholder claims 'cardholder_fraud' / unauthorized). Charge amount $2,300.00. They requested evidence within 48h. Can we assemble auth, session logs, confirmation emails, and any fraud flags?

billing-bot: ALERT: CHARGEBACK_OPEN id=dp_9Zx8 amount=2300.00 currency=USD reason=cardholder_fraud open_ts=1966123400

max_support: Ticket #7102 attached. User emailed: "I didn't approve this charge, my card was stolen". We forced a password reset and blocked API keys on Mar 25. Agent notes say user confirmed the reset. I'll attach the redacted transcript and support notes.

heidi_risk: Triage notes: auth AVS=N, CVV matched, auth IP geo=CA, billing country=US, device fingerprint differs from prior logins. Two failed login attempts before payment. No prior disputes on acct. Recommend include: auth receipt, gateway risk decision, device fingerprint history, and any recent account recovery flow.

ana_ops: Uploaded API call history and usage report to disputes bucket: s3://redwood-disputes/INV-110233/api_history_20260325.csv and session_logs_20260325.json. Also webhook delivery receipts for invoice and confirmation email.

leon_legal: We'll need TOU acceptance evidence + confirmation email header (Message-ID, timestamp) and redacted support transcript. If we submit, include chain-of-custody note for logs. Confirm PII redaction before submission.

paul_billing: Core txn details for packet: 
```
Invoice: INV-110233
Charge ID: ch_Fz8bX
Amount: $2,300.00
Customer acct: bg-9922 (EdgeApps Inc)
Card: **** **** **** 9012
Auth code: 662314
Acquirer reason: cardholder_fraud / unauthorized
Open_ts: 1966123400
```

billing-bot: Reminder: evidence window 48 hours. Current time left ~36 hours.

max_support: Pasting redacted ticket snippet: > agent: "We processed the Pro upgrade on Mar 25 and sent confirmation to billing@edgeapps.com" > user: "I did not authorize this, my card was stolen"

heidi_risk: I'll prepare a short narrative explaining indicators of legitimate account usage: prior successful logins from related IP range, consistent API usage pattern for 3 months, and confirmation email sent to billing address. Also note the password reset and key revocation timeline.

leon_legal: Please ensure the narrative avoids speculative language. Stick to facts and timestamps. Once uploaded I'll review.

paul_billing: Evidence assembled and uploading to Disputes Dashboard: https://console.redwood.inference/disputes/INV-110233. Tagging @leon_legal and @heidi_risk. ETA final review 20m.

billing-bot: Evidence submitted id=dp_9Zx8 status=evidence_uploaded timestamp=1966123515

heidi_risk: Reviewed packet. Small ask: include gateway risk score screenshot. I'll add and confirm.

leon_legal: Confirmed redactions and chain-of-custody note present. Submit.

paul_billing: Submitted to acquirer. Monitoring for retrieval/outcome. :eyes:
